Branch opening notes.

The north branch opens at nine in the morning on weekdays and at ten on
Saturdays. It closes on Sundays and on public holidays.

The south branch shares the same hours but keeps a late opening until eight
in the evening on Thursdays. Study rooms at the south branch need a booking
made at least one day in advance.

Both branches accept returns through an outside drop box at any hour. Staff
clear the drop box at opening time and check each item before they close
the loan.
